purpose: Define the paired Linhe validation inputs needed before Paper12 can be assessed as an ArcGIS or Esri-reference replacement candidate.
non_goals: Do not create or infer manual labels.
Do not run ArcGIS or Esri services.
Do not upgrade the ArcGIS replacement claim without paired evidence.
column_rule: Each row must include sample_id plus either a mask path or a scalar label for manual, ArcGIS, and Paper12 evidence.
path_resolution: Mask paths are resolved relative to the manifest CSV location.
supported_mask_formats: raster masks when rasterio is installed

decision_rule.not_validated: Use when required paired evidence is missing.
decision_rule.partial: Use when paired evidence exists but Paper12 is below ArcGIS beyond tolerance on mIoU or any critical class.
decision_rule.replacement_candidate: Use only when Paper12 matches or exceeds ArcGIS within tolerance on mIoU and all critical classes.
